In symmetric matrix blocks (P,M,Q), TX+XT=0 and vanishing diagonals require double-centering of M and constant opposite row sums in P,Q. Unsigned vertex-edge incidence kernels have rank m for m>=3 but rank 1 for m=2, and an orthogonal mixed phi adds one dimension; their projector adds exactly and yields the boxed dimension and diagonal capture laws. Every other eigenmode decays under arbitrary strictly positive losses.
